mapper.insert: insert into batch.external_event_delivery_alias (tenant_id, idempotency_key, delivery_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{deliveryId}) on conflict (tenant_id, idempotency_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select tr.workflow_definition_id, wf.workflow_code, tr.request_id, tr.trace_id, tr.request_status, wr.id as workflow_run_id, wr.run_status as workflow_run_status, tr.related_job_instance_id, ji.instance_status, greatest(tr.updated_at, coalesce(wr.updated_at, tr.updated_at), coalesce(ji.updated_at, tr.updated_at)) as updated_at from batch.trigger_request tr join batch.workflow_definition wf on wf.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and wf.id = tr.workflow_definition_id left join batch.workflow_run wr on wr.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and wr.trigger_request_id = tr.id left join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and ji.id = tr.related_job_instance_id where tr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tr.external_event_source = #{eventSource} and tr.external_event_id = #{eventId} order by tr.workflow_definition_id
